newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs still bullish if above 128.50.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs still bullish if above 128.50.

text.p: June BTPs must hold above 128.50 if they are to have any chance of a push higher on Wednesday, technical analysts said.
They suggested 128.50 to 128.65 should be seen as a buying area ahead of an eventual push towards 129.70 and 130.00.

"As long as 128.50 holds today, the June contract is likely to hit 129.70 -- but that becomes more of a reality if we get above 129.00," said David Wood, an independent technical analyst based near London.
By 0817 GMT, the June BTP was down 39 basis points at 128.63, off its opening at 129.02.
Wood said a fall below 128.50 would leave the market vulnerable to a move down to an initial target of 128.00, or even 127.20.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Markets, said although BTP prices were overbought, there were no signs of momentum slowing in the market just yet.
"This suggests further strength can be looked for over the coming days," he said.
"Against this background we use short-term setbacks onto 128.50 as a buying opportunity looking for strength to 130.00 in due course."
Adcock said further to the downside, stops should be placed under 128.15.
By 0837 GMT, June Eurolire were down seven basis points at 93.21.
Analysts said there was short-term support at 93.16, the potential neckline of a head-and-shoulders which would target 93.78 if it was confirmed.
